findings.title: Only three package entries verified before scheduled-task admission
findings.evidence: requiredPaths checks runtime/node.exe, bin/host-supervisor.mjs and task profile only; every other manifest entry is parsed but its bytes/ACL are not verified
findings.consequence: Imported lib modules, operation catalogs and package.json can differ from approved package while registration accepts the three top-level hashes
findings.required: Before task mutation verify complete qualified dependency closure, hashes and ACL/reparse boundaries; missing/extra/tampered dependency must fail before Get/Register-ScheduledTask. Pure/static regression only; do not install.
